name: Alaska

agency.name: Alaska Oil and Gas Conservation Commission, Department of Commerce, Community, and Economic Development

form.name: Permit to Drill (application, Form 10-401)
form.number: Form 10-401; the Forms page was said (search summary, not read) to carry an updated version required from 2026-04-01
form.notes: The blank form could not be read: commerce.alaska.gov answered 403 to this machine's HEAD and to the fetch tool, and I did not retry or look for a mirror of the PDF. Cells follow the text of 20 AAC 25.005 (permit to drill), 25.010, 25.025, 25.050, 25.055 and 25.065, read in the Alaska Administrative Code, Title 20 chapter 25 PDF at https://dec.alaska.gov/media/18482/03-08-20aac25.pdf (a copy last modified 2019-09-25; section 25.005 history ends 12/28/2006, so later amendments are not covered), plus the AOGCC flyer. Every form cell is therefore evidence 'doc' (what the rule requires), not 'form' (what the form asks); the form may ask for more (county, elevation, field and so on, left unknown).

api_number.n: Api in wells.xlsx and wellhistory.xlsx (14 digits; the 11th and 12th give the sidetrack code)

permit_number.n: Permit in both files; each sidetrack and lateral leg has a Permit to Drill of its own

well_name.n: WellName in both files; the operator designates the name (20 AAC 25.005(f))

lease_name.n: Leases in wells.xlsx (filled on 10,104 of 12,063 wells); the plat identifies the property (25.005(c)(2))

operator_name.n: OperatorName in wells.xlsx and wellhistory.xlsx; the applicant is the operator

operator_id.n: No operator number column in either file; not verified on the application

bond.n: Evidence of 25.025 bond with the application (25.005(c)(12)); Form 10-402A surety or 10-402B personal

county.n: No borough column: AreaName names the Commission's area (Arctic Slope, Cook Inlet Basin...); form not read

field_pool.n: FieldName and PoolNames in wells.xlsx; pool rules exist (20 AAC 25.520)

surface_latlon.n: Wh_ReportedLatitude/Longitude and Wh_Calculated... (each also with an '83' version) in wells.xlsx

surface_plss.n: Wh_Section, township, range, meridian and footages (Wh_FeetNorthSouth/EastWest) in wells.xlsx

bottom_hole_loc.n: Bh_Reported and Bh_Calculated latitude/longitude (10,012 wells calculated) in wells.xlsx; PBh_ columns too

lateral_path.n: Deviated wells: plat of proposed path and nearby wells (25.050(b)); surveys sent by request only (flyer)

elevation.n: GroundElevation (5,576 wells), KellyBushingElevation (11,415) and CasingFlangeElevation in wells.xlsx

surface_owner.n: Plat shows property owners (25.005(c)(2)); surface vs mineral split not verified

well_type.n: PermittedClass (Development, Exploratory, Service, Stratigraphic Test) and PermittedStatus in wells.xlsx

work_type.n: No column: the sidetrack digits of the Api (00 original, 01-05 sidetracks, 60-65 laterals) tell a redrill

well_direction.n: Intentionally deviated wells carry the extra path plat (20 AAC 25.005(d), 25.050(b))

proposed_depth_md.n: Depth at top of each objective and at TD (25.005(c)(2)(C)); the files hold only DrillerTotalDepth, as drilled

proposed_depth_tvd.n: Rule uses true vertical depth for pressure gradient (c)(4)(A); TrueVerticalDepth in wells.xlsx is as drilled

lateral_length.n: Not in the rule text; form not read

target_formation.n: Plat gives depth at the top of each objective (25.005(c)(2)); PoolNames in wells.xlsx is not shown to be the target

formation_tops.n: Objective tops (c)(2); exploratory wells add predicted geo-pressured strata depths (c)(9)

casing_program.n: Complete proposed casing and cementing program (20 AAC 25.005(c)(6))

cement_program.n: Part of the casing and cementing program (20 AAC 25.005(c)(6))

pressure_control.n: BOPE diagram and description (c)(3); diverter system diagram (c)(7)

h2s.n: Commission writes H2S conditions on the PTD where history is thin (25.065(c)); not an applicant item

pit_waste.n: Plan for mud and cuttings disposal and any annular disposal request (25.005(c)(14)); fluid program (c)(8)

water.n: No water source or volume item in 20 AAC 25.005(c); form not read

fracture_plan.n: No fracturing item in 20 AAC 25.005(c); form not read

frac_dates.n: Well history file dates 'Well Fractured' and 'Stimulate' events, one date each (job day or report day not stated)

frac_chemicals.n: Required on Form 10-404 and via FracFocus (20 AAC 25.283); the Data Miner only logs that a disclosure was filed

frac_additives.n: Form 10-404 must list trade name, supplier and purpose of each additive (20 AAC 25.283(h)); not in the Data Miner

frac_amounts.n: Form 10-404 must give each additive's amount and each ingredient's percent by mass; not in the Data Miner files

spacing_unit.n: Units set by pool rules (25.055); no application item verified

spacing_exception.n: Separate exception application with notice, plat, affidavit (25.055(d)); not on 10-401 itself

mineral_owner.n: Plat must identify the property and its owners (20 AAC 25.005(c)(2)); 25.005(h) right to drill

fee.n: $100 payable to State/AOGCC in the 2019-posted rule text (c)(1); current amount not checked

notice_hearing.n: Deviated wells: list operators within 200 ft, certified-mail copy or state sole owner (25.050(b)(2))

date_received.n: 'Dt Application Received (10-401)' events in wellhistory.xlsx (4,419 events)

date_approved.n: 'Dt Well Permit Approved' event in wellhistory.xlsx on every permit; 'Issued' is the same day for 98%

date_expires.n: Expires 24 months after approval if not spudded (25.005(g)); the history has only 29 'Permit Expired' events

spud_date.n: SpudDate in wells.xlsx (9,605 wells) and 'Dt Well Spudded' events in wellhistory.xlsx

completion_date.n: CompletionDate in wells.xlsx (9,664 wells) and 'Dt Well Completed' events in wellhistory.xlsx

status.n: CurrentStatus and LastStatusChange in wells.xlsx (Plugged & Abandoned, Oil well, Permit expired...)

plat_image.n: Scanned well history files (permits to drill) by PTD number at the document browser (flyer)

form_image.n: Scanned permits to drill by PTD number (AOGCC flyer)

completion_report.n: Scanned well completion reports by PTD number (AOGCC flyer)

logs.n: Held by AOGCC; digital logs and surveys sent on request (flyer); online lookup not confirmed

production_link.n: Data Miner Production page: production, injection, storage, NGL volumes (AOGCC flyer)

grade_reason: The Data Miner's two 'ZIP (All Data)' exports are free, need no login and answer a plain automated request. The Well Work Dates file holds every dated event of every Permit to Drill (application received, approved, issued, spudded, completed), and the Wells file holds the class, status, area, field, depths, locations and elevations, so monthly approvals can be counted from 2019. Limits: the Commission gives every sidetrack and lateral leg its own permit (90 to 190 permits a year, about half for new holes), no recompletion or plug-back permit is dated, and no proposed depth is published. Updated 2026-11-01: both files were opened and a producer reads them weekly; its 2020 count (89 permits, 36 Arctic Slope oil wells) equals the Commission's own chart exactly, and 2018 is 3 percent above its count.
producer_plan: Built: d11_nat_ak.py. Two requests 3 s apart to the Data Miner's own export files (wellhistory.zip, wells.zip), read whole each run (about 9 s; the workbook uses prefixed XML tags, so the producer has its own small reader). Counts Permits to Drill by the 'Dt Well Permit Approved' event, one per permit, from 2019. Bands from the sidetrack digits of the well number and the class the permit was issued for: new = original hole of a Development or Exploratory permit; inj = original hole of a Service well; redrill = any sidetrack or lateral code; other = Stratigraphic Test; rework and amend are null (recompletions are sundry notices; 'Re-Issued' is not read as an amendment). Fluid from PermittedStatus; places are the Commission's areas. Refuses: a stale export (over 45 days), no approval in 45 days, a changed header, over 2% of approvals with no class, approvals and issues over 40% apart, a history over 10% smaller than the committed one. A 401, 403, 407 or 429 exits 2 and keeps the file.
privacy_notes: The files name operators (companies and a few agencies; the producer names only corporations, LLCs and partnerships) and carry a Leases column that can hold a landowner's name (never published). Scanned permits to drill and plats can name landowners and staff contacts: link nothing from them.
